TEXT: Do you have a moment?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hmm? What is it? Even though I finally got in the mood.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE

TEXT: But your legs are shaking.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Heh, I'm not going to chicken out after coming so far!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO

TEXT: Yes.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's too blunt! Be a little tactful!

TEXT: There's no need for that, know that I believe in you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Haha. Well, I guess it's true.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: You're indeed a burden, but that's all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hm? What do you mean by that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: This level of handicap is perfect.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Don't say I'm a handicap!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Handicap.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Don't say I'm a handicap!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm not like that at all--!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Besides, it seems like you're pretty confident.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: In a match, the one thinking about defeat before it starts is going to lose.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Kuroneko.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: If you lack self-confidence, hide behind me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: O-Okay...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: So you 'were' thinking about defeat.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Don't mess with me!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I too, can do things when I need to!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I hope so.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Don't take me for a fool! I've undergone training after all!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I can't lose when we've made it this far!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Heh, unknowingly your legs stopped shaking.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh?
She... did it to calm me down...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Can you do it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, yeah... No problem. Let's go, Kuroneko!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Yes.
I-I can't deny it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I'll say it now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: W-What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: On the battlefield, there is no "good effort", only winners and losers.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It's not "I have to win" or "I want to win". It's "I win". Get it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Y-Yeah...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I can fight while covering you; we will still win.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: W- Where does this self-confidence come from?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I feel pity for your lack of self-confidence.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ugh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Because of that, that sister of yours always gets her way.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: How pitiful.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Shut up! You're making me lose more confidence!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Well then, should we go?
